title: The Beyond Signal
text: Admiral Richard Byrd led polar flights and expeditions for three decades. Years after his death, a diary attributed to him described a 1947 flight beyond the North Pole into a warm green land. Historians call the diary a forgery. The Navy mast you found in solid granite carries a plate dated 1947, and it keys one word, over and over, on a band nobody has used since the war.
teaser: A Navy mast in solid granite still keys one word.
